scripts.smoke: docker compose exec -T app php tools/phpunit.phar --testsuite smoke
scripts.unit: docker compose exec -T app php tools/phpunit.phar --testsuite unit
scripts.integration: docker compose exec -T app php -d memory_limit=1G tools/phpunit.phar --testsuite integration
scripts.fuzz: docker compose exec -T app php -d memory_limit=1G tools/phpunit.phar --testsuite fuzz
scripts.fuzz-baseline: docker compose exec -T app php -d memory_limit=1G test/Fuzz/regenerate-baseline.php
scripts.test: docker compose exec -T app php -d memory_limit=1G tools/phpunit.phar
scripts.stan: docker compose exec -T app php -d memory_limit=1G tools/phpstan.phar analyse

scripts-descriptions.smoke: Run the HTTP smoke suite against the running capsule. ONE process at a time — never fan this out in parallel.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan against the module sources. Contract is 'no new errors': pre-existing ones live in phpstan-baseline.neon.
scripts-descriptions.fuzz: Run the form input-validation fuzz harness. No HTTP, read-only DB. Contract is 'no new gaps': pre-existing ones live in test/Fuzz/known-form-gaps.php.
scripts-descriptions.fuzz-baseline: Regenerate test/Fuzz/known-form-gaps.php. Review the diff: every added line is a validation gap being accepted.
scripts-descriptions.integration: Run the integration suite. Needs memory_limit=1G for the same reason `fuzz` does, and since batch 10 for literally the same code: three of its tests build every form in the application through test/Fuzz/FormRepository, which is what costs the memory. Measured 2026-08-15 — at the default 512M it dies partway through TranslationWriteSemanticsTest, which is merely where the limit happens to land.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run every suite in one process. Needs memory_limit=1G for the same reason `fuzz` does: Books\Form\Publication's factory calls getKeywordsValueOptions(), which loads every publication row, and at the default 512M it exhausts the limit once the earlier suites' memory is already held. Measured 2026-08-07 — it failed identically before this batch.
